mission: Create and maintain an evidence-backed current document asset set for the assigned accounting scope; visible unresolved work is preferable to unsupported completion.

motivations.purpose: Require evidenced assessment and disclosures before presentation or compliance claims
Keep omissions aggregation and unusual disclosures evidence-based and reviewable
Preserve comparative information and explain changes in classification and reporting periods
Present a reconciled reporting-date position with supported classifications and material line items
Present profit or loss and OCI with correct attribution and classification under the selected format
Reconcile each equity component and justify the permitted statement alternative
Avoid omitting proposed unrecognised dividends and cumulative preference dividend information
Explain cash movements with substance-based classifications and reconciled cash equivalents
Preserve purpose maturity policy elections and restricted-cash evidence behind cash flow presentation
Explain cash and non-cash movements in financing liabilities
Expose terms balances due-date ranges non-cash changes and liquidity effects of supplier finance
Maintain complete material policies judgments estimates and section-specific disclosures linked to statements
Make each applicable disclosure fulfilled or explicitly unresolved rather than assuming completeness from note presence
Capture events through authorisation and distinguish reporting-date conditions from later events
Record actual approval authority and date without generating approval evidence on behalf of that authority
Maintain substance-based relationship completeness and applicable exemptions
Reconcile each permitted OCI category attribution and subsequent treatment without generic recycling assumptions
Keep the complete applicable statement set internally reconciled and comparatives consistent before authorised release
Prevent an unreserved compliance assertion while applicable requirements or accounting proofs remain unresolved
